focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 六级（CET-6）/ 雅思大作文（Task 2）/ 托福独立写作：深度论证与让步反驳（BP33–BP40）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 核心正方分论点段：主张 -> 机制推演 -> 具象行业微案例 -> 扣题闭环（PEEL 满分段）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写大作文的第一个主体段（Body Paragraph 1）：论证某个核心优势或必要性，做到有理有据、有具象场景支撑，绝不车轱辘话来回说。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL 议论文核心主体段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [分论点主题句 Topic Claim]：一句话清晰亮出本段唯一控制中心（[Policy/Factor X] strengthens [Outcome Y] by [Core Mechanism]）。
S2 [因果机制推演 Causal Elaboration]：Explain HOW and WHY：阐明如果没有这层干扰或有了这项机制，认知/经济/技术流程会发生什么具体改变。
S3 [具象微观案例 Concrete Micro-Case]：For instance, when [Specific Group/Industry] [Specific Action], [Measurable/Observable Consequence]（绝不编造假百分比，用具体场景细节说话）。
S4 [反事实对比或扣题升华 Warrant / Link Back]：Thus, [Summary Noun] shifts human effort from [Low-value Routine] toward [High-value Judgment].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Topic Claim -> Causal Mechanism -> Concrete Micro-Case (L021) -> Warrant Closure. 绑定逻辑规则：L006, L012, L021.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: First, AI can improve working efficiency a lot. People have many boring tasks every day. If AI does these tasks, people can save time and do better things. For example, my friend uses AI to write emails and saves two hours every day. So AI is very helpful.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: ① 口语词泛滥（a lot, boring tasks, better things, my friend）；② 个人化琐碎举例（my friend saves two hours）不符合学术议论文语域。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Delegating repetitive data compilation to automated systems enables professionals to concentrate on high-level diagnostic judgment. In data-intensive fields such as clinical medicine and structural engineering, practitioners traditionally spend hours cross-checking routine telemetry logs before formulating a hypothesis. When hospital radiology departments deploy automated screening algorithms to flag normal chest scans, physicians can redirect their cognitive bandwidth toward ambiguous pathology cases and patient consultation. Consequently, intelligent triage elevates both diagnostic throughput and clinical care quality.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 学术演讲（Tech Talk）/ 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）/ 科研个人陈述（SoP）（BP41–BP48）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 顶会 Rebuttal 针对“创新性存疑（Limited Novelty / Incremental）”的有力澄清段
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想回复审稿人最致命的质疑：'The method seems like a simple combination of existing Module A and Module B (limited novelty).' 既不顶撞审稿人，又能用理论+消融数据证明“绝对不是简单拼凑”。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: 顶会 Rebuttal 核心争议攻防段（Novelty Defense）
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [礼貌接招并定位误解核心 Courteous Reframing]：We appreciate Reviewer X's comment on architectural design and would like to clarify the fundamental distinction between our coupled formulation and a naive combination of [A] and [B].
S2 [点破简单拼接为何会失败 Why Naive Combination Fails]：Directly stacking standard [A] and [B] fails on [Problem] because [Theoretical Conflict / Gradient Interference].

S3 [阐明本文核心数学/机制桥梁 Our Core Coupling Innovation]：Our core contribution lies not in using [A] or [B] in isolation, but in deriving the [Specific Coupling Mechanism C], which resolves [Conflict] by [Mathematical Guarantee].

S4 [用直接对比实验一锤定音 Empirical Proof of Non-Triviality]：To verify this empirically, we implemented the exact naive concatenation baseline (`Naive A+B`) in Table R2: our coupled formulation outperforms `Naive A+B` by [14.6%] in MSE, confirming that the performance gain stems from our coupling mechanism rather than mere module stacking.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Clarify Distinction -> Explain Why Naive Stacking Fails -> Highlight Core Coupling Mechanism -> Prove with 'Naive A+B' Ablation Data. 绑定逻辑规则：L019, L016.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: We disagree that our paper lacks novelty. Although A and B existed before, nobody used them together on time series forecasting. Also our results are very good, so our paper is novel.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 承认了“只是把现成的 A 和 B 第一次拿到这个任务上拼起来（nobody used them together）”，等于坐实了審稿人的 A+B 拼凑指控！
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: We appreciate the opportunity to clarify how our architecture differs fundamentally from a naive combination of spectral filtering and neural ODEs. Directly stacking an FFT block with a standard neural ODE fails under abrupt regime shifts because spectral normalization strips the exact boundary values required to initialize the ODE trajectory. Our core technical innovation lies in the bidirectional phase-scale coupling operator (Eq. 7), which uses instantaneous spectral entropy to gate ODE stiffness while feeding predicted scale bounds back to regularize frequency attention. To verify this empirically, we implemented a direct `Naive FFT + ODE` concatenation baseline in Table R2 below: our coupled formulation reduces 720-step MSE by 15.2% over `Naive FFT + ODE`, confirming that the gain stems from our mathematical coupling rather than module stacking.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 六级（CET-6）/ 雅思大作文（Task 2）/ 托福独立写作：深度论证与让步反驳（BP33–BP40）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 深层原因剖析段：表层诱因与结构性根源双层挖掘（Dual-Layer Causal Diagnosis）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想在问题分析类作文（Why is this happening?）中，剖析某个社会/科研痛点背后的深层原因（既指出直接表层诱因，又挖出底层的考核激励或结构性根源）。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 原因分析段，或学术评论文章
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [原因总起句 Dual-Cause Thesis]：The widespread emergence of [Problem X] stems from both immediate technological pressures and deeper institutional incentives.
S2 [第一层：直接操作/技术诱因 Immediate Driver]：At the operational level, [Factor A] lowers the cost of [Behavior], tempting individuals/organizations to [Short-term Action].

S3 [第二层：深层制度/激励根源 Structural Root Cause]：More fundamentally, existing evaluation systems reward [Superficial Metric] rather than [Long-term Quality], creating powerful pressure to prioritize speed over rigor.
S4 [双因叠加后果 Compounding Effect]：When effortless generation meets quantity-driven evaluation, [Problem X] becomes systemic rather than isolated.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Dual-Cause Opening -> Immediate Operational Driver -> Deeper Institutional Root -> Systemic Compounding. 绑定逻辑规则：L007, L005.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Why do many students copy AI answers directly? First, AI is very easy and fast to use. Second, students are lazy and have too much homework. So they just copy and paste.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 把复杂社会教育现象简单归结为“学生懒（students are lazy）”，缺乏操作成本与评价体系两个层面的结构化深度。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: The growing tendency among undergraduates to submit unverified AI-generated essays stems from both lowered friction costs and flawed assessment design. At an immediate level, conversational models produce grammatically polished drafts within seconds, tempting time-pressed students to bypass the arduous process of outlining and primary reading. More fundamentally, many university courses still rely on generic, formulaic essay prompts that reward surface fluency rather than original empirical critique. When effortless text generation meets standardized grading rubrics that fail to penalize hollow reasoning, superficial compliance inevitably crowds out deep inquiry.

focal_blueprints.genre_adaptation_notes: 用 At an immediate level... 与 More fundamentally... 剥洋葱般剖析“极低生成摩擦成本”与“奖励表面流利度的公式化命题考核”，末句 When A meets B, C inevitably crowds out D 极具思辨穿透力。

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 概念浓缩指代词（This/Such + Summary Noun）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 严禁单独使用裸露的 This / That / It 指代上一整句话！必须在指示代词后紧跟一个精准概括上一句本质的抽象范畴名词（如 This discrepancy / Such degradation / These computational constraints / This trade-off）。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Sentence 1: [Full empirical observation or limitation]. -> Sentence 2: This/Such [Summary Noun: bottleneck / discrepancy / vulnerability / shift] + [Active Verb: motivates / necessitates / limits / explains]...
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 句首单写 'This makes the model slow' 或 'Which causes error'，审稿人和雅思考官无法判断 This 究竟指上一句的主语、宾语还是整件事。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Diffusion models require hundreds of iterative denoising steps at inference time. This prevents them from running on onboard robot controllers.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Diffusion policies require hundreds of iterative denoising steps at inference time. This computational latency prevents them from running at closed-loop control frequencies on onboard robot hardware.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 用 This computational latency 将上一句“数百步去噪迭代”精准定性为“计算延迟”，既消除了指代歧义，又完成了因果定性。

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 一段一核：单一控制中心法则（Single Controlling Idea Rule）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 一个自然段只能回答一个核心问题（例如：这一段只讲“为什么频域滤波能抑制传感器高频噪声”，就绝不要在同一段末尾顺手塞进“此外我们还开源了代码并降低了显存”）。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Topic Sentence (Controlling Idea X) -> Mechanism of X -> Evidence for X -> Boundary/Synthesis of X. (Move Concept Y to Next Paragraph).
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 一段话里既讲精度、又讲速度、还顺带抱怨数据集质量，导致段落像杂货铺一样失焦。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Our spatial-temporal attention block captures cross-sensor correlations accurately. Also, training takes only two hours on a single GPU, and the public dataset we used has some missing timestamps that we interpolated linearly.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Our spatial-temporal attention block captures dynamic cross-sensor correlations by weighting neighbor nodes according to instantaneous phase lag. This phase-aware aggregation prevents faulty sensors from corrupting adjacent channels during localized hardware spikes, reducing multi-sensor MAE by 11.8%.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 砍掉无关的训练耗时与数据清洗杂音，全段聚焦于“相移感知图注意力如何隔离故障传感器并提升多传感器预测精度”。

focal_revision_cases.domain_en: Academic Tech Talk & Conference Oral Delivery
focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 顶会口头汇报（Tech Talk）与图表引导
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想写大作文的第一个主体段（Body Paragraph 1）：论证某个核心优势或必要性，做到有理有据、有具象场景支撑，绝不车轱辘话来回说。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: First, AI can improve working efficiency a lot. People have many boring tasks every day. If AI does these tasks, people can save time and do better things. For example, my friend uses AI to write emails and saves two hours every day. So AI is very helpful.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L004 概念浓缩指代词（This/Such + Summary Noun））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.5_colloquialism_and_ai_cliches: ① 口语词泛滥（a lot, boring tasks, better things, my friend）；② 个人化琐碎举例（my friend saves two hours）不符合学术议论文语域。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.6_quantitative_or_instance_grounding: 缺乏 Metric-Baseline-Condition 三元组（L010）或具象行业微观案例（L021）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.7_voice_and_constituent_clarity: 谓语动词弱化为 be/make/get/have，未发挥强及物动词的骨架支撑作用。

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Delegating repetitive data compilation to automated systems enables professionals to concentrate on high-level diagnostic judgment. In data-intensive fields such as clinical medicine and structural engineering, practitioners traditionally spend hours cross-checking routine telemetry logs before formulating a hypothesis. When hospital radiology departments deploy automated screening algorithms to flag normal chest scans, physicians can redirect their cognitive bandwidth toward ambiguous pathology cases and patient consultation. Consequently, intelligent triage elevates both diagnostic throughput and clinical care quality.

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Figure 2 illustrates the overall architecture of DyTS-Net, which maps raw sensor streams to multi-horizon forecasts through three sequential stages. Given an input sequence $\mathbf{X}$, the Adaptive De-stationary Tokenizer first separates local trend-scale statistics from normalized sub-series patches $\mathbf{Z}_0$. These normalized patches then pass through stacked Spectral-Spatial Mixing blocks, which jointly filter high-frequency channel noise in the Fourier domain and propagate cross-sensor phase dependencies via a sparse directed graph. Finally, the Scale-Guided Decoder fuses the refined structural representations with the projected neural-ODE scale trajectory to reconstruct the multi-horizon output $\hat{\mathbf{Y}}$.
